findings.current: no fewer than a hundred thousand cultists set foot in the Central Plains
findings.defect: “Cultists” identifies the group but loses the source’s disparaging implication in 사이비—false or pseudo-believers. The accepted baseline’s “so-called heretics” retained more of that attitude.
findings.rationale: The source calls them 사이비, not simply followers of a cult; this choice carries a dismissive judgment that the current neutral label omits.
findings.replacement: no fewer than a hundred thousand so-called heretics set foot in the Central Plains

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor loss of the source’s dismissive wording for the Demonic Cult’s followers.
